## Ratfolk Explorer (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 Male ratfolk rogue 6  
 LN Small humanoid (ratfolk)  
 **Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +10  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 15 [21 vs. rays], flat-footed 14 [17 vs. rays] (+3 armor [+6 vs. rays], +4 Dex, +1 size)  
 **hp** 48 (6d8+18)  
 **Fort** +5, **Ref** +9, **Will** +3  
 **Defensive Abilities** evasion, uncanny dodge, trap sense +2  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 15 ft.  
 **Melee** mwk scimitar +7 (1d4+1/18–20)  
 **Ranged** +1 pepperbox rifle +10 (1d8+1/x4)  
 **Special Attacks** sneak attack +3d6, swarming  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** The explorer drinks his potion of invisibility.  

 **During Combat** The explorer uses his rifle to fight opponents from a safe distance. Otherwise, he flanks with any allies to make sneak attacks with his bleeding attack rogue talent.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 13, **Dex** 18, **Con** 16, **Int** 12, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 8  
 **Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 18  
 **Feats** Improved Initiative, Rapid Reload (pepperbox rifle), [Weapon Focus (scimitar)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Deadly Aim](../../rules/feats/deadly-aim.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Deadly Aim needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (scimitar).*  
 **Skills** Appraise +7, Bluff +5, Climb +8, Craft (alchemy) +3, Diplomacy +5, Disable Device +8, Handle Animal +2, Heal +10, Intimidate +5, Knowledge (geography) +2, Knowledge (local) +7, Knowledge (nature) +2, Perception +10, Ride +6, Sense Motive +10, Stealth +13, Survival +7, Swim +8, Use Magic Device +10; **Racial Modifiers** +2 Craft (alchemy), +2 Perception, +2 Use Magic Device  
 **Languages** Common, Gnoll  
 **SQ** rogue talents (bleeding attack +3, hard to fool [2/day], survivalist), trapfinding +3  
 **Combat Gear** potions of cure light wounds (2), potion of cure moderate wounds, potion of invisibility; **Other Gear** masterwork red scatterlight suit, masterwork omniweave armor, masterwork scimitar, +1 pepperbox rifle with 20 metal cartridges, antitoxin, sunrod (2), tindertwig (15), 16 gp
